answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 164539 Country: India Title: Using of Mobile tower money in masjid Question: In our masjid, there is one room which is adjacent to our masjid in which we have made toilets and wudhukhana. On the first floor of it we have constructed one room which is on rent. On the terrace of it we have installed the mobile tower. Mobile company gives rent of that place half yearly basis. Is it jaiz to use the money coming from mobile tower to use in masjid expenses. Answer ID: 164539 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1346/1122/N=01/1440) The room on first floor which is built above the hall of wudhukhana and instinjakhana if its veranda does not come under the boundary of Shariah mosque and there is no threat to the mosque due to mobile tower then it is lawful to install mobile tower. And the rent which is paid by the mobile company every six month is lawful and may be spent in mosque necessities because the user will be responsible for the wrong use of net or mobile not the mosque trustees. However, no long-term contract should be made with the mobile company for the installation of tower so that in cases of need in future the place may be vacated quickly. However, it is far better to have any other resource for the income of mosque instead of mobile tower. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
